SELECT place_of_perform_state_name, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE coalesce(place_of_perform_state_name, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many categories of federal award does USAspending distinguish?
Which antipsychotic drugs are prescribed most under Medicare Part D?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Geography And Drug

SELECT brnd_name, try_cast(tot_clms AS double) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND antpsyct_drug_flag = 'Y' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug) ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many words long is a granted patent's typical independent claim?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(pat_wrd_avg AS double)), 1) AS avg_words FROM govblock_patents.claims_patent_document_stats
How many clinicians earned a perfect MIPS score of 100?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cc_ec_score_file WHERE try_cast(final_mips_score AS double) = 100
Where is coronary heart disease most common among adults, by county?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS county, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_county WHERE measureid = 'CHD' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND year = '2022' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many federal facilities reported toxic releases in 2022?
SELECT count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' AND _21_federal_facility = 'YES'
In which states are homes worth the most, by median value?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_home_value FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b25077' AND a.variable = 'B25077_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In what share of office actions does the examiner find claims obvious?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(rejection_103 = '1') / count(*), 1) AS pct_obviousness FROM govblock_patents.oa_research_office_actions
How many kindergarteners attended New York public schools in 2024-25?

SELECT sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS kindergarteners FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator LIKE 'Category Set A%' AND st = 'NY' AND grade = 'Kindergarten'
How often does OIRA clear a rule unchanged, change it, or see it withdrawn?
SELECT decision, count(*) AS reviews, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did the federal government owe in 1790?
SELECT try_cast(debt_outstanding_amt AS double) AS debt FROM govblock_treasury.debt_outstanding WHERE record_date = '1790-01-01'
How has Veterans Affairs contract spending in Florida changed from 2018 to 2025?

SELECT action_date_fiscal_year, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'FL' AND action_date_fiscal_year BETWEEN '2018' AND '2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
How do registered clinical studies stand: completed, recruiting, terminated or other?
SELECT overall_status, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE overall_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal contract actions went to companies in Buffalo in fiscal year 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE upper(recipient_city_name) = 'BUFFALO' AND recipient_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025'
How have U.S. exports to Mexico changed year by year?
SELECT year, max(try_cast(all_val_yr AS double)) AS exports FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_cty WHERE cty_name = 'MEXICO' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of campaign operating spending went to advertising in the 2020 cycle?

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN category_desc LIKE 'Advertising%' THEN transaction_amt ELSE 0 END) / sum(transaction_amt), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2020'
How did the average U.S. residential electricity price change from 2004 to 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.PRICE.US-RES.A' AND period IN ('2004', '2024') ORDER BY 1
How many words do Florida's statutes run to in all?
SELECT sum(try_cast(word_count AS bigint)) AS words FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'fl' AND document_type = 'statute'
How many generating technologies does the Annual Technology Baseline cover?
SELECT count(DISTINCT technology_alias) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_atb_atbe
How do the two chambers of the Texas legislature compare in size?
SELECT chamber, count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE state_file LIKE 'tx-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which categories of medical equipment reach the most Medicare patients?
Medicare Durable Medical Equipment Devices Supplies By Geography And Service

SELECT rbcs_desc AS category, sum(try_cast(tot_suplr_benes AS double)) AS beneficiaries FROM govblock_health.medicare_durable_medical_equipment_devices_supplies_by_geography_and_service WHERE rfrg_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_durable_medical_equipment_devices_supplies_by_geography_and_service) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many water discharge inspections were carried out by EPA itself rather than a state?
SELECT count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections WHERE state_epa_flag = 'E'
Which nursing home deficiencies are cited most often?
SELECT deficiency_description, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_healthcitations WHERE deficiency_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
For how many currencies does the Treasury publish reporting rates?
SELECT count(DISTINCT country_currency_desc) AS n FROM govblock_treasury.rates_of_exchange
Which parts of the Energy Department funded the most patented inventions?

SELECT coalesce(level_two, fedagency_name) AS office, count(DISTINCT patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_gov_interest_org WHERE level_one = 'Department of Energy' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many approved drugs does ChEMBL list for obesity?
SELECT count(DISTINCT molregno) AS drugs FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_indication WHERE mesh_heading = 'Obesity' AND max_phase_for_ind = 4
Which teaching hospitals received the most research money from drug and device makers?

SELECT teaching_hospital_name, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_research WHERE teaching_hospital_name IS NOT NULL AND teaching_hospital_name <> '' AND teaching_hospital_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many annual reports on Form 10-K reached EDGAR in 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS annual_reports FROM govblock_sec.submissions_filings WHERE form = '10-K' AND substr(cast(filingdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2025'
Where do children under 15 make up the largest share of a metro area's people?

SELECT name, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN try_cast(agegrp AS integer) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN try_cast(tot_pop AS double) END) / sum(CASE WHEN try_cast(agegrp AS integer) = 0 THEN try_cast(tot_pop AS double) END), 1) AS pct_under_15 FROM govblock_census.popest_cbsa_est_alldata_char WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '7' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Form 4 reports did Tesla insiders file in 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission WHERE issuertradingsymbol = 'TSLA' AND document_type = '4' AND filing_date LIKE '%-2022'
Which counties have the most facilities with significant violations?

SELECT concat(fac_county, ', ', fac_state) AS county, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE fac_compliance_status = 'Significant Violation' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many SAM.gov registrants are based outside the United States?
SELECT count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_country_code <> 'USA'
Which federal district courts handled the most civil cases in the Federal Judicial Center's database?
SELECT c.full_name, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_courts.fjc_integrated_database AS f JOIN govblock_courts.courts AS c ON c.id = f.district_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Maryland or Virginia get more federal contract dollars in fiscal year 2019?

SELECT primary_place_of_performance_state_code, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code IN ('MD', 'VA') AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2019' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
What kinds of charter do active FDIC-insured institutions hold?

SELECT CASE bkclass WHEN 'N' THEN 'National bank' WHEN 'SM' THEN 'State member bank' WHEN 'NM' THEN 'State nonmember bank' WHEN 'SB' THEN 'Savings bank' WHEN 'SA' THEN 'Savings association' WHEN 'SL' THEN 'State savings institution' WHEN 'OI' THEN 'Insured branch of a foreign bank' ELSE bkclass END AS charter, count(*) AS institutions FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE active = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
